records.name: Caribbean Netherlands (Bonaire, Sint Eustatius, Saba)
records.note: no prison-housing data found. Wikipedia full-text search for 'transgender prisoner Caribbean Netherlands Bonaire prison' (MediaWiki API) returned only generic hits (LGBTQ rights by country or territory, Demographics of the United States, same-sex marriage in Argentina) with no Caribbean-Netherlands-specific trans-prisoner placement, special-unit, or segregation content. World Prison Brief country profile for Bonaire/Sint Eustatius/Saba and alternative slugs (caribbean-netherlands, netherlands-antilles, curacao) all returned HTTP 404, and the Council of Europe CPT Denmark country page returned HTTP 403 (blocked); no documented case, ruling, or practice on where trans prisoners are housed in the Caribbean Netherlands (birth-sex vs identity placement, solitary/segregation) was located within budget.
